name: Railcraft High Pressure Boiler 1x1
notes: Railcraft high-pressure steam boiler (1x1 firebox, Railcraft 9.17.31, the version in GTNH 2.9.0-beta-3). Solid firebox at the base, high-pressure tanks above; no walls (fireboxes and tanks only, per the wiki). It cannot wallshare and must be at least one block from another boiler (minGap 1). Hatches are not modelled. One tank layer.
